decisions.reason: The commission recipient change is already represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY setting recipient_selection to random existing ticket holder.
The source changes recipient selection only when no referral code is entered; coded-referral ticket issuance remains unchanged.
The source changes the no-referral recipient and does not alter commission allocation for a mint using a referral code.
Changing the no-referral ticket recipient does not alter the NFT token serial used as the referral code or its display locations.
The candidate was introduced from the same source message and already incorporates the supplied About-page revision; no additional propagated MODIFY is necessary.

The existing FAQ copy says random existing NFT holder, but the source is framed as an About-page revision. It is unclear whether the client also intends the previously approved FAQ copy to be revised.
Selecting a random existing ticket holder for no-referral allocation does not necessarily change which NFT attributes and active tickets follow an NFT upon transfer.
No-referral ticket recipient selection does not change prize payout mode, claim control, or claim surface.
The recipient terminology does not necessarily alter the required metadata counters, badges, or referral-code attributes.
The no-referral recipient change does not affect the Aave provider, prize-pool yield source, or deposit behavior.
Recipient selection for newly allocated no-referral tickets does not change ticket eligibility, expiration, burning, reset, or carry-forward behavior.
The source does not change secondary royalty amount, structure, disclosure, prize-pool funding, or ticket-creation behavior.
